title: MZ Sharing Core JavaScript Engine Updates

posts.author: mattalaga1
posts.body:
Hi all,
I have recently been learning about custom plugin development, but run in to frustration trying to untangle the core JavaScript engine. Local development in an IDE like VSCode (Visual Studio Code) often has difficulty automatically determining typehints, or jumping to function declarations due to the complex hierarchy of overrides. (This is even after setting up
LunaSense - RPGMakerMV/MZ Intellisense
)
For my own sanity, I've been rewriting core files to support modern JS conveniences, particularly ES6 classes and modules.
I would like to share these files with the community, for other programmers interested in better learning the engine, or as an aid for plugin development. However, I don't want to violate any licensing terms, since these are modified copies of the core RPG Maker engine, rather than a standalone plugin. I came across a similar resource in
RPG Make MZ Typescript edition
which leads me to think these files would be okay to make publicly available on GitHub, but I would rather get confirmation first. And if it
is
okay to share on GitHub, what license would be most appropriate?
Thank you!
mattalaga1
